notes.title: New Release - The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings Enhanced Edition, 15% off!
notes.notes:
The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings Digital Premium Edition is now available on Steam and is 15% off until April 23rd at 10am Pacific time!

In the second installment of the RPG saga about the Witcher, Geralt of Rivia, enjoy a captivating story, dynamic combat system, beautiful graphics, and everything else that made the original Witcher such a great game. The Enhanced Edition includes hours of additional gameplay with new locations, an expanded storyline and new characters, mysteries and monsters!
